Invented fixture preamble for Fixture Co widgets.

9 [TEST FIXTURE - NOT SYLLABUS TEXT] Fixture Co records a widget agreement in its imaginary register.

10 [TEST FIXTURE - NOT SYLLABUS TEXT] Fixture Co records the widget unit price in its imaginary register.

11 [TEST FIXTURE - NOT SYLLABUS TEXT] The fictional ledger uses a blue token for each widget.

22 [TEST FIXTURE - NOT SYLLABUS TEXT] Fixture Co groups its imaginary widget notes.

(a) [TEST FIXTURE - NOT SYLLABUS TEXT] The first note describes a pretend brass widget.

(b) [TEST FIXTURE - NOT SYLLABUS TEXT] The second note describes a pretend paper widget.

27A [TEST FIXTURE - NOT SYLLABUS TEXT] A made-up label identifies a purple widget.

B28 [TEST FIXTURE - NOT SYLLABUS TEXT] A fictional box contains a widget-shaped wooden token.

B29 [TEST FIXTURE - NOT SYLLABUS TEXT] Fixture Co paints a green stripe on the wooden token.

B30 [TEST FIXTURE - NOT SYLLABUS TEXT] The imaginary stripe has no effect outside this fixture.

IE3 [TEST FIXTURE - NOT SYLLABUS TEXT] Fixture Co stores an invented widget in a cardboard moon.

## Fixture Scope

C1 [TEST FIXTURE - NOT SYLLABUS TEXT] This fictional paragraph is only about pretend widgets.
